answer: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded jointly to John J. Hopfield and Geoffrey E. Hinton for their foundational contributions to machine learning using physics-based methods, as described in the Nobel Prize 2024 motivation/summary for Physics [S6][S1].
